about_the_game:
Infiltration & Awakening is a story-rich spy game set in a wartime era. Players will choose an exclusive undercover role and carry out core missions such as code-breaking, stealing secrets, rescuing captives, and assassinating leaders in a perilous environment.

In terms of operation, you need to control the protagonist to move across the map, dig out key clues through dialogue prompts, and exchange intelligence with comrades via secret signals. You can quietly sneak behind enemies to eliminate them, or knock them out and take their clothes to blend into their ranks and hide your identity. Only by successfully completing rescue, secret-stealing or assassination targets and escaping smoothly can you achieve mission victory—the whole process fully embodies the tension and strategy of spy warfare.

  • Choose an undercover role to start your mission.

  • You can eliminate enemies silently from behind.

  • Victory is achieved after successfully rescuing captives, stealing secrets or assassinating leaders, and then escaping safely.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game contains strong language and extreme violence.
